features: Adobe OAuth Server-to-Server on the fixed IMS v3 endpoint
Rust Adobe product-profile membership with organization, profile ID, name and type confirmation
Slack auth.test context verification followed by Rust SCIM 2.0 users
Workspace and Enterprise scopes cannot be interchanged
Existing Microsoft, Google and GitHub read protocols preserved

checks.postgresFulfillmentTests: not repeated; this change adds no database path

buildInfrastructure.initialFailure: Docker build cache exhausted local builder storage
buildInfrastructure.resolution: Removed five verified unshared OpenDirectory Cargo build caches (about 1.4 GB)

limits: No real Adobe, Slack or other provider credential/consent/live connection was used.
The manual probe does not write the database, import catalog entries, allocate capacity or run a synchronization worker.
Adobe UMAPI and Slack SCIM administrative scopes can authorize writes; the implementation only reads resource endpoints. Slack auth.test is a non-mutating POST.
Rust HTTP fixtures and Node process fixtures were tested separately. Artifact smoke rejects invalid tokens before any network request.
Adobe metadata reads are limited to five pages per probe; all new user captures are bounded to 1000 rows and 16 user pages.
Provider pagination is not an atomic snapshot. Membership, profile quota and active accounts are not purchased capacity.
Atlassian, JetBrains and GovSlack are not implemented.
The pre-existing OpenBao synchronization outage was not repaired.
